trapFamily.trap: vendor shape in the port: the SMS provider's submit response, delivery report, delivery states, throttling error (retryAfterSeconds) and blocked-recipient error (blockReason) leak into the ports and the reminder and booking services

subGoals.rule: Ports and the application core speak the application's own language; the SMS provider's report, field names, delivery states and block reasons stay in the adapter (Cockburn P1: each adapter talks to the application through a port).
The core has no runtime dependency on the vendor SDK: provider throttling (and refusals) reach it as its own errors (Cockburn P1).

precedent: clean-shaped: the existing text-message port (application/ports/out/TextMessages.ts) is written in the application's own types (PhoneNumber, SentText) and the Textwave adapter translates to the SDK's submit({ to, from, body }) and back from its messageSid.
